text_01: Recorded demonstrations of the running system, captured on the Digilent ZYBO (Zynq-7000) board. Videos are muted and play only on demand.
text_02: Real-time color-based detection & tracking: the target's RGB signature is matched per pixel and the object is localized by row/column bounds (TR/TC min–max), live on the Zynq.
text_03: Sobel edge-detection filter running on the Digilent ZYBO (Zynq-7000) with HDMI input and VGA output.
text_04: Execution-time and accuracy comparison of the detector in MATLAB vs OpenCV vs HLS on the Zynq:  the FPGA/HLS implementation processes each frame far faster at matching accuracy.
